summary: Midnight tower: card gives position, John Rule and 1963 photo captions; towermen list places several staff at Midnight from 1968 to 1994; no build or fate source.

staffing.status: towermen listed at Midnight: Chris Rule (1968-1970, marked unofficially), Tracy Lockhart (1977-1994), Hilda Switzer Lundgren and John Rule (both undated for Midnight)

events.note: Chris Rule listed at Midnight, which the list marks as unofficial, and at Cold River, 1968 to 1970.
Tracy Lockhart listed at Midnight and Birch, 1977 to 1994.

evidence.supports: Card names John Rule as towerman
Photo captions on the card are dated 1963
Chris Rule listed at Midnight (marked unofficially) and Cold River, 1968 to 1970
Tracy Lockhart listed at Midnight and Birch, 1977 to 1994
Hilda Switzer Lundgren listed for seven towers including Midnight, with service dated 1957 and 1970 to 1994
evidence.quote: Hilda Switzer Lundgren 1957, 1970-1994 7 towers Northend Montreal Lake, Birch, Big Sandy, Elk House, North Cabin, Midnight, Holbein

evidence.supports: John Rule listed for four towers including Midnight, with no dates
evidence.quote: John Rule 4 towers Cold River, Divide,Mistohay, Midnight

notes_for_editor: The card coordinates match the record (53-38-22.2 X 108-22-39.5 = 53.6395, -108.37764), so no correction. No source gives a build date, height, status or access for Midnight. The 1963 captions date photographs, not construction, so no build event is recorded. Chris Rule's entry marks the name as unofficial and the sources do not explain why; the story reports the marking without interpreting it. Wikipedia's Midnight Lake article (53.5001, -108.3507, RM of Parkdale No. 498) was read but no source ties the lake to this tower, so it is not used. The brief's agency (SPSA) is unsupported. firelookout.ca slugs midnight-fire-tower, midnight-tower, midnite-fire-tower and midnight-lake-fire-tower all return 404. Search budget was exceeded: three searches were run for this tower against a limit of two.
